test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Lavani is the dance form of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lavani is a folk dance from Maharashtra.**
 
• It is a combination of traditional song and dance, which is particularly performed to the beats of the Dholki which is a percussion instrument.
 
• It is noted for its powerful rhythm and has contributed substantially to the development of Marathi folk theatre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lavani, the most popular dance form of Maharashtra derives its name from Lavanya, which is translated as beauty. 
 
• It is performed **by beautiful women wearing nine yards sarees and dancing to the beats of a drum-like instrument called a dholak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed57b6b73f99656e0f7a8ee83dd20db1991930096be3ff51c2f103ffee0063df.png]
